notablePrerequisites: Warchanter Skald has at least one Aura and/or Equipment attached.
description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Warchanter Skald and another artifact, targeting Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token that is also an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.
